title: Ten years under the table
arc: Ten Years Under the Table / The Dog Night
logline: The Dog Night extended to five. The dog is ten. The walks are the same. The strip is not.

panels.composition: The dumpster. The bulb. The dog is ten. He sits before Wood stops walking.

image.prompt: a man and a gray-muzzled dog behind a bowling alley at night under a bulb, the dog already sitting before the man has stopped walking, muddy watercolor, no words

panels.composition: The dog. Ten. The eyes cloudier. Drawn with the same four strokes as 2000 and two more.

image.prompt: close-up of an old dog's face under a bulb, eyes slightly cloudy, drawn in a few tender strokes, no words

panels.composition: Wood sitting on the gravel. The dog climbing into his lap, which he has never done here.

image.prompt: a man sitting on gravel at night as an old dog climbs into his lap under a bulb, no words

panels.composition: Walking away, slowly, the dog carried the last stretch. The sign, all lit.

image.prompt: a man walking away under a fully lit bowling-alley neon sign carrying an old dog in his arms, watercolor, no words
image.notes: The first time he carries him. It's short. It's a preview.

art.line: brush-pen; the flats cleaner; the Sundays the point now

notes: Ten. Carried the last stretch. The strip is previewing 2014 without knowing.
